cases.name: Regina La’Shall Metcalf-Phillips
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She attended and graduated from Dallas ISD, A. Maceo High School in 1988. She was a State Employee for CPS for 19 years and a Human Services Advisor for 5 years. She was a proud mother of three children. Regina was loved by everyone she touched."
cases.narrative: On 5/6/2024, she was found shot in the head after firefighters responded to a fire at her apartment. Police believe Rias shot his her in the head sometime between Sunday night and early Monday morning.
